mostWorthwhile.text: Building the printing press was most worthwhile: its explanation clarified how the block, screw and plate work together.

leastWorthwhile.text: Preparing the ink at the press was straightforward but less engaging than building it.

surprise.text: The iron became a screw in the press, clarifying a connection I hadn't understood when choosing the combination.

arbitrary.text: The printing block and iron combination initially lacked a clear purpose for me, although the result explained it.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested to see what the settlement does with printing next, especially after the explanation of how the press works.
